title: code_index.move_symbol request
description: Move a top-level Rust, TypeScript/JavaScript, or Python declaration to another module. The declaration moves with its attributes or decorators and the comment block directly above it; every import and qualified use of it across the workspace is rewritten, the destination gains imports for the names the declaration uses, and the source re-imports it when still needed. A missing destination is created (for Rust, the parent module also gains a `mod` declaration). All-or-nothing: every planned file is re-parsed before anything is written.

proof.description: Include bounded edit excerpts and per-file syntax evidence. Does not run a project check.

symbol.description: Name of the declaration to move. Alias: `name`.

path.description: File that declares it, workspace-relative or absolute. Alias: `file`.

to_path.description: Destination file in the same language family. Aliases: `target_file`, `destination`.

line.description: 1-based line of the declaration when several share the name.

kind.description: Symbol-graph node kind that narrows the seed.

allow_visibility_widening.description: The widest visibility the move may add to unblock itself; omit to refuse instead (the default). Rust takes `pub(super)`, `pub(crate)` or `pub`; TypeScript/JavaScript takes `export`; Python has no levels and rejects the parameter. When the declarations that block the move need a level no wider than this, each is widened to the narrowest level that reaches the modules that use it, and `widened` lists every change. A blocker the engine cannot place exactly (a constructor or pattern of a struct with hidden fields, a `pub(in ...)` path, a decorated TypeScript declaration, a private member matched by name whose owning type the moved code does not name or whose name is shared) still refuses.

dry_run.description: Plan and validate every edit, return them under `result: "dry_run"`, and write nothing. Defaults to false.

session_id.description: Optional staged-fs session id; reads and writes go through its overlay.
